card_mechanisms.title: Brand behavior versus name recognition
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Test price realization, retention and purchase response against comparable unbranded substitutes.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Promotional discounts rather than durable preference explain apparent loyalty.

card_mechanisms.title: Runway and capital allocation
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Trace incremental capital deployed into eligible projects to incremental after-tax cash returns; high incumbent profitability is insufficient.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Shrinking profitable opportunity set drives value-destructive acquisition despite strong moat.

card_mechanisms.title: Intangible investment denominator
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Compare consistent capitalization/amortization scenarios before judging software versus asset-heavy ROIC.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Capitalized development fails to retain customers or create future cash flows.

candidates.boundary: Historical interview-based synthesis, not current portfolio recommendations; interview speaker distinguish from magazine authors.

sources.title: Reflections on Liquidity and Capacity
sources.locator: PDF pp0–2, ownership cap/capacity, volume liquidation and redemption discussion, signaturep2
sources.read_scope: PDF pp0–2, ownership cap/capacity, volume liquidation and redemption discussion, signaturep2
claims: Voting ownership cap, minimum portfolio weights and cross-strategy overlap constrain capacity.
Historical turnover-based liquidation estimates may deteriorate under market stress.
Redemption execution must consider remaining holders as well as those exiting.
sources.caveat: May2019 masthead; archive indexedApr30. Historical assumptions are not current fund liquidity. Current hosted footer updated; exact original publication day not asserted.

card_mechanisms.title: Customer-data feedback loop
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Track contribution rights, differentiated analytics and retention rather than dataset size.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Competitors obtain equivalent data or usage permission is revoked.

card_mechanisms.title: Investment strategy capacity
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Under simplified equal voting/economic share assumptions, AUM ceiling = allowed equity ownership value / minimum position weight, net of other mandates.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Dual-class voting or cross-strategy ownership invalidates naive market-cap ceiling.

card_mechanisms.title: Redemption versus liquidation liquidity
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Stress cash buffer and sale participation against correlated redemptions and falling turnover; avoid dumping only liquid assets.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Long holding horizon does not prevent sudden client redemptions.

candidates.boundary: Individual signed reasoning about team portfolios, no sole attribution of investment performance.

sources.title: Quantifying Quality
sources.locator: PDF pp0–4 body/signature; p5 approval footer
sources.read_scope: PDF pp0–4 body/signature; p5 approval footer
claims: Sector and quality-factor labels do not uniquely describe portfolio exposures.
Backward-looking profitability screens can miss future improvement.
sources.caveat: June masthead/June3 approval footer; archiveMay31 discrepancy. Hosted copyright2024, original content version not archived. Backtests and team performance not independently replicated.

sources.title: A Very Long Hill
sources.locator: PDF pp0–3 body; pp5–6 signature and caveats; p7 footer
sources.read_scope: PDF pp0–3 body; pp5–6 signature and caveats; p7 footer
claims: Compounding outcome depends on both earnings growth and duration.
A finite multiple compression has horizon-dependent annualized effect.
Investor cash-flow timing differs from fund time-weighted return.
sources.caveat: US survivorship and small-sample caveats explicit. Formula concerns price return, not dividend-inclusive total return; future growth is an assumption.

card_mechanisms.title: Factor attribution versus selection
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Compare matched sector/style exposure before inferring skill; test on independent periods and include failed holdings.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Chosen backtest periods or stock examples manufacture apparent alpha.

card_mechanisms.title: Improvement versus trailing quality screen
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Map specific operating changes to forward margin/return evidence rather than extrapolate trailing ROE.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Low profitability persists and narrative improvement never reaches cash flow.

card_mechanisms.title: Growth duration versus derating
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Price ratio=(1+earnings growth)^years*(exit PE/entry PE); calculate dividends separately.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Growth slows, earnings are diluted or the company fails before the assumed horizon.

candidates.boundary: Independent signed essays; qualitative methodology not proof that factor replication is impossible or buy-and-hold always superior.

card_mechanisms.title: Position size versus thesis
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Separate risk-budget rebalance from revised intrinsic-value judgment; test concentration under correlated shocks.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Trim justified as size discipline conceals actual thesis deterioration.

card_mechanisms.title: Quality company in excess capacity
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Test replacement demand against customer financing and industry spare capacity before extrapolating company quality.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Share gains or competitor exits restore economics despite aggregate weak demand.

card_mechanisms.title: Demand-driver diversification
card_mechanisms.editor_model: Map earnings to customer budgets and cyclicality, then stress common drivers rather than count sector labels.
card_mechanisms.counterexample: Nominally diverse software/industrial positions share the same capex funding constraint.
